messages:
taylor: heads-up: deploy-bot blocked the canary push for api-gateway (staging -> canary). webhook shows a manifestlist/platform mismatch AND provenance annotation drift across regions. pasted bot log. thoughts?

deploy-bot: publish blocked (code 409).
  image: public.ecr.aws/redwood/api-gateway:staging-canary-20260322
  reason: manifestlist-missing-platform(arm64) + provenance-annotation-drift (gcr->ecr)
  detected: manifestlist only contains amd64; upstream mirror had cosign.attestations.kms=true but ecr mirror stripped annotation
  recommended_actions: [republish-multiarch, pin-prev-digest, escalate-replication-team]

jess: did the smoke job run? any runtime regressions?

taylor: smoke passed on amd64 nodes. no arm64 smoke run was scheduled for this canary. publishing failed before K8s rollout due to registry-level checks.

nelly: oof. two risks: 1) republish as multiarch (build + push) to restore arm64 + correct cosign annotation — longer and may fail if the builder lacks rotated cosign key; 2) pin previous digest to keep canary traffic on current image and open a ticket for republish in change window.

vikram: recommend pinning. We just had a cross-account replication change last week that can strip OCI annotations during mirror. If we republish now we might just re-create the same mirror problem until replication config is reverted.

jess: okay pin seems safest. but we need audit entries and release notes: callout for "mirror removed provenance annotations; republish scheduled" and the pinned sha. Also add an ops task to verify replication preserves OCI annotations.

deploy-bot: executing pin-prev-digest -> pinned public.ecr.aws/redwood/api-gateway@sha256:7f4a2... (previous canary digest). rollback-block cleared.

nelly: creating ticket RE-4599: "api-gateway: republish multiarch w/ preserved provenance". Tasks: (a) verify cosign key on builder; (b) build multiarch manifest (amd64+arm64); (c) attach cosign attestation with KMS annotation; (d) test cosign.verify-attestation on staging mirror endpoint; (e) coordinate replication team to ensure annotations pass-through. ETA: next maintenance window 03:00-05:00 UTC.

vikram: note for the ticket: include `skopeo inspect --config` output from both src and mirror to show annotation difference. Also verify that the mirror isn't running a policy to strip OCI annotations.

jess: release notes line: "Canary held: registry mirror removed provenance/KMS annotations and required multiarch republish; pinned to previous digest; republish scheduled during maintenance window. Internal action: RE-4599."

taylor: thanks. I'll ping support and the replication team. leaving thread open until RE-4599 is staffed and we validate preflight steps. If someone wants to try an emergency republish before the window, post here with risk justification. :warning:
